# `kaolin/metrics/HausdorffDistance.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/metrics/HausdorffDistance.js`

HausdorffDistance.js — Maximum surface deviation metric Measures the worst-case distance between two point sets or meshes. Hausdorff(A, B) = max( max_{a∈A} min_{b∈B} ||a-b||, max_{b∈B} min_{a∈A} ||b-a|| ) Variants: - Standard Hausdorff (max of mins) - Percentile Hausdorff (e.g. 95th percentile — more robust to outliers) - Directed Hausdorff (one direction only) Used by: mesh quality validation, LOD error bounds, surface fitting.

## Functions

### `hausdorffDistance(pointsA, pointsB, options = {})`

Compute Hausdorff distance between two point sets.

**Parameters:**

- `pointsA` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `pointsB` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.symmetric` *(boolean)* — — compute both directions (default true)
- `options.percentile` *(number)* — — use percentile instead of max (0-100, default 100 = exact)

**Returns:** }

### `directedDistances(pointsA, pointsB)`

Compute per-point minimum distances from A to B. Returns the distance of each point in A to its nearest neighbor in B.

**Parameters:**

- `pointsA` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `pointsB` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3

**Returns:** — per-point distances (not squared), length = nA
